changes: The bounty board now explains how to start: create a private target or browse rewards. Open it with Highground: /hg bounty. Standalone Bounties: /hgb. Standalone Nearby: /hgn bounty.
Create bounties, inspect rewards and review claims in one window. Back to board keeps your search and position; numbered forms explain who sees the bounty and what happens next.
My bounties, Guild board and Shared board are the main views. Suggestions and settings move under More tools; How it works reopens the guide.

Shared reward details offer Report kill and Add a reward. Claims & payments explains review and manual payment. Long forms scroll at enlarged text sizes; empty history and claims lists no longer show blank rows.
notice: After updating, /reload loads this release; no new addon files were added. Keep HighgroundBountyData enabled for Highground, Bounties and Nearby. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
